idea: Animals & their sounds #1 (GRANDMA'S FARM): a big friendly cow pops her head over the white fence right beside Baby Jimmy ('Wow! A big cow! Moo, moo!'); he moos back (say it with me: moo!); a fluffy white sheep trots up ('The sheep says baa!'); a little brown hen hops onto the fence post ('Cluck, cluck, cluck!') and Jimmy flaps his arms like wings (copy-me); then all three stand with him and Jimmy asks the viewer 'Who says moo? Hmm?' (pause) – 'The cow! Moo, moo!'; lesson 'Every animal has its own sound!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now cow, hen and sheep together and a bye-bye wave.
lesson: Farm animals and their sounds: the cow says moo, the sheep says baa, the hen says cluck.
place: GRANDMA'S FARM (text-only block, section 4 – no reference image; hook frame used as place anchor for every later frame)
calendar: Wednesday slot 1 – Animals & their sounds / nature (first farm-sounds episode).

variety.outfit: Jimmy HOME (light blue onesie, barefoot) – the OUTDOOR outfit was tried first but the model copied the sheet's onesie; HOME matches the sheet best (1 Nov lesson)

characters: Jimmy (HOME): BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue short-sleeve onesie with a small yellow star, barefoot.

supporting_objects.cow: THE COW: a cute round friendly black-and-white spotted cartoon cow with a soft pink nose, big shiny dark eyes, small rounded cream horns and floppy ears, toy-like and never scary.
supporting_objects.sheep: THE SHEEP: a cute round fluffy white cartoon sheep with soft cloud-like curly wool, a cream face, big shiny dark eyes, small floppy ears and little black hooves, toy-like and never scary.
supporting_objects.hen: THE HEN: a cute round little brown cartoon hen with a small red comb, a tiny yellow beak, big shiny dark eyes and fluffy wings, toy-like and never scary.

setting: GRANDMA'S FARM: a small friendly farm with a red barn, a white fence, green fields, a cow, a sheep, hens and a tractor. (Per frame: only the animals already introduced are in the picture.)

learning.goal: Name three farm animals and the sound each one makes: cow – moo, sheep – baa, hen – cluck.
learning.shown_how: One animal at a time, big beside Jimmy's face, each making its sound (mouth/beak open) with the real animal sound effect on the cut: cow over the fence (shots 1-2), sheep beside him (shot 3), hen on the fence post (shot 4); then all three together (shot 5).
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:20 'Who says moo? Hmm?' over the loop shot with all three animals (question boing) + 0:20-0:22 humming pause → 0:22 'The cow! Moo, moo! Yay!' on a cow-mooing cut + real moo
learning.copy_me: 0:03-0:07 'Say it with me: moo, moo!' (hands cupped by the mouth) and 0:11-0:15 'Flap your wings with me!' (Jimmy flaps his arms like a hen)
learning.fact_check: Cow = moo, sheep = baa, hen = cluck (correct English animal sounds); exactly ONE cow, ONE sheep, ONE hen on screen (counted in every frame); animals appear in song order; no text/letters/numbers/signs anywhere.
learning.modeling: Jimmy is gentle with the animals (soft pat on the sheep), curious and joyful; no wrong choice to correct.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, friendly round toy-like animals, bright calm farm, one baby, big face, nothing scary.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: a cow pops up by the fence – MOO!
copy-me: flap your wings like a hen

story_order.cow: shot 1 appears (hook) · shots 2 and 5 present (out of frame in 3-4)
story_order.sheep: shots 1-2 absent · shot 3 appears · shot 5 present (out of frame in 4)
story_order.hen: shots 1-3 absent · shot 4 appears · shot 5 present
